excluded.item: Presentation-only widescreen variants (BPS-only prototypes, e.g. the earlier sonic1-widescreen package)
excluded.reason: Superseded by the native widescreen packages; not part of v0.1.0 and never migrated.
Authoring-time experiments for the SDK, not user-facing releases; never migrated.
Replaced by sonic2-native-widescreen 3.0.1 (and the REV01 package); their digests are not published.

excluded.item: Original game images, patched images, BIOS or disc images
excluded.reason: Forbidden by docs/publication-restrictions.md; only SHA-256 digests identify them.

excluded.item: Extracted graphics, sound, level data, disassembly or reconstructed source
excluded.reason: Forbidden by docs/publication-restrictions.md; a BPS delta of at most 4 KiB cannot reconstruct them.

excluded.item: Private authoring inputs and tooling used to regenerate the BPS from an original image
excluded.reason: Needs a game image; regeneration stays private. Rebuilding a package from source/ needs none.
